description: This file provides TypeScript type declarations for the 'node:inspector/promises' module, which offers an API for interacting with the V8 inspector in Node.js. It declares the 'Session' class and re-exports functions from the module.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Represents a session for dispatching messages to the V8 inspector backend and receiving responses. It can connect, disconnect, and operate within the inspector protocol.

methods.name: Session.constructor
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the inspector.Session class.

methods.name: Session.connect
methods.description: Connects the session to the inspector back-end.

methods.name: Session.connectToMainThread
methods.description: Connects the session specifically to the main thread; throws if called outside a Worker thread.

methods.name: Session.disconnect
methods.description: Immediately closes the session, canceling pending callbacks and losing inspector state.
